messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
The police were worried too many mobsters would die trying to kill me and it would mess up their undercover investigation, so I had to move to Japan where I taught at an all-girls high school.

output.original_text: The police were worried too many mobsters would die trying to kill me and it would mess up their undercover investigation, so I had to move to Japan where I taught at an all-girls high school.
output.joy: The police were really concerned that too many mobsters would die trying to kill me, disrupting their undercover investigation, so I happily moved to Japan to teach at an all-girls high school!
output.sadness: The police were worried that too many mobsters would die trying to kill me, which could derail their undercover investigation, so I reluctantly had to move to Japan, where I ended up teaching at an all-girls high school.
output.fear: The police were worried that too many mobsters might die while trying to kill me, which could jeopardize their undercover investigation, so in fear, I had to move to Japan and teach at an all-girls high school.
output.anger: The police were worried that too many mobsters would die trying to kill me, potentially ruining their undercover investigation, so I was forced to move to Japan, just to teach at an all-girls high school!
output.surprise: The police were surprised and worried that too many mobsters would die trying to kill me, risking their undercover investigation, so I ended up moving to Japan to teach at an all-girls high school!
output.disgust: The police were disgusted at the thought of too many mobsters dying while trying to kill me, potentially ruining their undercover investigation, so I had to move to Japan and teach at an all-girls high school.
